'''Rivostan''' is the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Capital capital] of [[Emara]], a foundational [[Ayuma|Ayuman]] state and the seventh-largest national economy by nominal [[List of countries by GDP (nominal)|GDP]] in the world. The city had a population of 14,967,000 at the [[Emara|Emaran]] 1764 census, ranking it the [[List of cities and dependencies by population|fifteenth-largest city in the world]] by population. Rivostan is the political and cultural centre of [[Emara]], a three-time [[FLLA World Cup]] champion and host of the [[1672 FLLA World Cup|1672]], [[1704 FLLA World Cup|1704]] and [[1728 FLLA World Cup|1728]] editions.
